A [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] simply known as "'''Gray'''" was the representative of [[Chiss family/Legends|one]] of the ruling [[Ruling Families/Legends|Four Families]] of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. He wore a [[Color/Legends|silver-gray]] head-to-foot [[Chiss robes of state|robe]].<ref name="Refugee" />
